name: Gemma 4 31B + calibration playbook

settings.serving: vLLM 0.28.0, reasoning parser gemma4, tensor parallel 2 on A40 GPUs

notes: All 100 frozen chips: the first 10 run 2026-10-30, the other 90 2026-10-31 to 2026-11-02. Guided track: the maintainers' calibration playbook (an 11 kB experimentalist strategy prompt, not published) appended to the system prompt; otherwise identical to the raw Gemma 4 31B entry. Long episodes span several chained jobs and resume from per-turn checkpoints; the prompt is rebuilt from the restored environment, so a resume is invisible to the model.
